# Effect: delay

Delay/echo: repeats the signal after a set time.

**Where to put it**: Good for lead, chords and vocals; put it before the reverb. Setting time from the tempo keeps it in sync: 60/tempo seconds = one beat.

Latest parameters: `muser effects delay` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time_seconds` | 0.3 | 0 – 10 s | Echo interval. Set it from the tempo: quarter note = 60/tempo, eighth = 30/tempo, dotted eighth = 45/tempo |
| `feedback` | 0.35 | 0 – 0.99 | Echo repeats. 0.2 one or two; 0.4-0.5 many; >0.7 builds up for a long time |
| `mix` | 0.3 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 0.2-0.35 normal; >0.5 echoes louder than the original |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "delay", "time_seconds": 0.35, "feedback": 0.4, "mix": 0.3 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Eighth-note echo @120bpm (time = 30/tempo)

  ```json
  {"type": "delay", "time_seconds": 0.25, "feedback": 0.35, "mix": 0.3}
  ```

- Dotted eighth @120bpm (time = 45/tempo, the classic pop/rock lead)

  ```json
  {"type": "delay", "time_seconds": 0.375, "feedback": 0.4, "mix": 0.3}
  ```

- Slapback short echo (vintage vocals/guitar)

  ```json
  {"type": "delay", "time_seconds": 0.11, "feedback": 0.0, "mix": 0.25}
  ```

- Dub long echo (repeats many times)

  ```json
  {"type": "delay", "time_seconds": 0.5, "feedback": 0.65, "mix": 0.4}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- Compute time_seconds from the tempo for the echoes to land in time: quarter = 60/tempo, eighth = 30/tempo, dotted eighth = 45/tempo, sixteenth = 15/tempo.
- With feedback > 0.7 the echoes pile up into a sustained roar; only suitable for dub or transitions.
- Long echoes on dense, fast notes turn muddy; echoes suit phrases that leave gaps.
